vulnerabilities.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
vulnerabilities.description: No Content-Security-Policy header was detected on the primary origin domain.
vulnerabilities.ai_fix_prompt: Add a Content-Security-Policy header in Next.js next.config.js headers configuration restricting script-src to 'self'.

vulnerabilities.title: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Missing max-age
vulnerabilities.description: HSTS header is present but missing includeSubDomains directive.
vulnerabilities.ai_fix_prompt: Update Strict-Transport-Security header to include 'max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload'.
